authorization: User approved original versus reference-expanded passage, prompt and model unchanged. Six fresh single-note calls: three per condition.
question: Does spelling out the CEO referent in the later source paragraph reduce generated subjects that leave that referent implicit?
changed_factor: Only the second source paragraph. Add CEO context to development, tracking, trajectory and fundamentals. Preserve quotation including clipping, URL, source order and other wording.
synthetic_identity: The explicit condition is a manually edited diagnostic input, not an authentic Nostr note; its separate note_id prevents confusion with the source.

review.primary: For each specific subject about the commentator's changed thesis, tracking for months, undeniable trajectory, or aligning fundamentals, does the item independently identify the CEO-related matter? Exact wording is not required. A reference to this/the matter/the development/this post without CEO identification does not supply the context.
review.coverage: Record coverage of each of those four meanings independently; not generating an affected subject cannot count as successful context retention.
review.other_subjects: Review all subjects against their full condition-specific input using the unchanged semantic standard in ../plan.json. Broad, nested, overlapping, duplicate subjects, plausible implications and supported interpretations remain allowed.
review.identity_hiding: Independent reviewer receives all six complete input/output pairs with opaque IDs in shuffled order; trial and condition names withheld. The input edit itself is visible so condition blinding is not possible.
review.originals_preserved: All previous generated output, judgments, prompts and user decisions remain unchanged.

decision.support: Original has target context errors in at least 2/3 outputs; explicit has zero such errors in 3/3 and covers all four target meanings in each. Directional evidence that this source edit helps this case.
decision.persistence: If explicit still loses CEO context in at least 2/3 outputs while representing the affected meanings, local source reference expansion is insufficient.
decision.otherwise: Mixed result or original failure not reproduced: inconclusive at this six-call bound. Report exact outputs; no automatic rerun.
decision.scope: This is not final validation and cannot promote a prompt/model or authorize preprocessing.

limits: One previously troublesome note; not general performance.
The edit increases CEO repetition, length and salience as well as resolving references. A positive result cannot isolate which of these caused the change.
Success does not prove how the model internally understood the original; failure does not prove it failed to resolve the reference.
The original clipped quotation remains ambiguous; this test does not repair or score that as improved.

resources.admission: MemAvailable >=16GiB, memory PSI avg10<=1 and IO PSI avg10<=10.
resources.stop_owned_launchers: MemAvailable<8GiB or memory PSI avg10>10; no unrelated process may be stopped.
resources.caveat: Codex child scopes may escape launcher memory accounting; host checks remain required.

preflight: Independent read-only reviewer verified input edit and warned of the salience/repetition confound, recorded in limits.
